iocs.title: Dual_EC_DRBG default points (NIST SP 800-90A)
iocs.recommendation: Remove Dual_EC_DRBG; use CTR_DRBG or Hash_DRBG (NIST SP 800-90Ar1).

iocs.title: Debian OpenSSL weak keys (CVE-2008-0166)
iocs.recommendation: Regenerate all keys on affected Debian/Ubuntu hosts; check openssl-blacklist.

iocs.title: Hardcoded ECDSA nonce (Sony PS3 / CVE-2010-0740 style)
iocs.recommendation: Use RFC 6979 deterministic nonces or CSPRNG per signature.

iocs.title: Sub-512-bit RSA / export-grade keys (FREAK/Logjam class)
iocs.recommendation: Minimum RSA-2048; disable export cipher suites.

iocs.title: Embedded private key / hardcoded secret
iocs.recommendation: Remove embedded secrets; use vault/KMS with rotation.

iocs.title: Known-compromised certificate indicators
iocs.recommendation: Replace test/compromised certificates; pin production CAs.
